content.title: Empowering teams to shape their own future
A proven framework for success
content.description: Apply the same performance management strategy that's helped Revolut succeed. Define goals and skills, run objective reviews, then calibrate the results to ensure you identify, reward, and retain high performers .

items.title: Guaranteed goal alignment
items.description: Ensure everyone knows how to succeed. Set goals with clear criteria, then automatically export that data to the project management tools you already use, so all teams stay aligned on their top priorities.
items.caption: Goals

items.title: Monitor performance with precision
items.description: Unlock a comprehensive view of your team's achievements (and potential) with structured performance reviews that prioritise evidence over opinion.
items.caption: Reviews

items.title: Make data-driven decisions
items.description: Access crucial data insights on compensation, promotions, and development, so you always invest in the right people for the right reasons.
items.caption: Calibration

items.title: Ensure strategic progression
items.description: Build and trigger post-review plans like promotion roadmaps, performance improvement plans, and salary adjustments. Every employee gets a clear outcome, and every manager is accountable for next steps.
items.caption: Next steps

items.title: Empower your people with AI
items.description: Our built-in AI tools help you eliminate guesswork. Identify top talent as soon as they apply, guarantee fair and unbiased reviews, and access key insights on what keeps your team engaged and growing.
items.caption: AI

items.title: Make praise matter
items.description: Build recognition into your team’s daily workflow. Link peer-to-peer feedback to your company values, giving managers the context they need for impactful performance reviews.

items.title: Are there implementation fees?
items.description:
No, Revolut People charges zero implementation fees as standard and includes dedicated support from day one at no extra cost.

However, more complex organisations can request a fully bespoke implementation for an additional fee, which allows us to tailor the platform to your exact needs.

Request a demo.

items.title: Does Revolut People offer dedicated customer support?
items.description:
Yes, all Revolut People plans include access to dedicated support. You'll have a dedicated Customer Success Manager to assist you throughout your journey, ensuring you get the most out of the platform.

Additionally, our Support team is always available to provide personalised assistance whenever you need it. Just send an email or select 'Request help' on the homepage. Or use our AI chatbot to help you navigate the platform.

Speak with us about customer support options.

items.title: What currency will I be billed in?
items.description: Revolut People fees are charged in GBP, AED, or USD, depending on your location. This applies to all our products and services.

items.title: What is the minimum spend for Revolut People?
items.description: Our minimum annual spend is £5,000 or the equivalent in your local currency, which is required to cover all licensing fees.
